title: Add sieve-daemon workspace member to Cargo.toml
description:
Add the new sieve-daemon crate to the workspace.

What: Add crates/sieve-daemon to [workspace.members] in root Cargo.toml and create the crate skeleton (Cargo.toml with AGPL-3.0-only license, axum/tokio/serde_json/usenet-ipfs-sieve deps, empty src/main.rs).

Algorithm:
1. Edit root Cargo.toml: append 'crates/sieve-daemon' to members list.
2. Create crates/sieve-daemon/Cargo.toml with: name=usenet-ipfs-sieve-daemon, license=AGPL-3.0-only, deps: axum 0.8, tokio (full), serde/serde_json, tower, tracing, usenet-ipfs-sieve path dep.
3. Create crates/sieve-daemon/src/main.rs with a stub main() that prints 'sieve-daemon stub'.
4. cargo check -p usenet-ipfs-sieve-daemon must pass.

Defensive rules: no unwrap() in production paths; license field must be exactly 'AGPL-3.0-only'.
